book.name: 1 Abhakʉrintʉ
book.title: Ɨnyarʉbha ye embere ya Paaurʉ kwa Abhakʉrintʉ

content: Mʉnyɨgɨ inyɨ, chɨmbu inyʉʉsi nikwɨga Kiriisitʉ.
Ubhwɨndi bhwʉ ʉkʉsabha
Nɨrabhakumya kʉ kʉbha mʉranhiita mʉmangʼana gʉʉsi, na kugwata amiija ganʉ nabhahɨɨrɨ.
Nawe nereenda momenye kʉbha umutwɨ gwu umusubhɨ wʉwʉʉsi umwisirirya ni‑Kiriisitʉ, umutwɨ gwʉ ʉmʉkari umusubhɨ waazɨ, nu umutwɨ gwa Kiriisitʉ ni‑Mungu.
Umusubhɨ wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ akukundikirya umutwɨ hanʉ akʉsabha, hamwɨ hanʉ akorootorera, wuyo arasuucha Kiriisitʉ, newe umutwɨ gwazɨ.
Nawe ʉmʉkari wʉnʉ atakukundikirya umutwɨ gwazɨ hanʉ akʉsabha, hamwɨ hanʉ akorootorera, wuyo arasuucha umusubhɨ waazɨ, newe umutwɨ gwazɨ. Ɨrabhabhu, kʉ kʉbha arabha nchʉ ʉmʉkari wʉnʉ amwɨrɨ.
Arɨɨbhɨ ʉmʉkari atakukundikirya umutwɨ gwazɨ, amwɨ zinzwɨrɨ zaazɨ! Nawe nɨ‑sʉni kʉmʉkari kumwa zinzwɨrɨ, hakɨrɨku akundikiryɨ umutwɨ gwazɨ.
Ɨtakwenderwa kumusubhɨ kukundikirya umutwɨ, kʉ kʉbha ewe ne ekerenjo cha Mungu, na areerecha ʉbhʉgʉngʉ bhwa Mungu. Nawe ʉmʉkari areerecha ʉbhʉkʉrʉ bhu umusubhɨ waazɨ.
Nɨragambabhu kʉ kʉbha Mungu ataabhumbirɨ umusubhɨ kurwa kʉmʉkari, nawe akabhʉmba ʉmʉkari kurwa kumusubhɨ.
Na Mungu ataabhumbirɨ umusubhɨ igʉrʉ wʉ ʉmʉkari, nawe akabhʉmba ʉmʉkari igʉrʉ wu umusubhɨ.
Igʉrʉ wa riyo, naatu igʉrʉ wa bhamaraika, ʉmʉkari areenderwa kukundikirya umutwɨ gwazɨ, kwerecha kʉbha ari iyaasɨ wʉ ʉbhʉnaja bhu umusubhɨ waazɨ.
Nawe ku kugwatana nʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ, ʉmʉkari ariisega umusubhɨ, nu umusubhɨ ariisega ʉmʉkari.
Nɨragambabhu, kʉ kʉbha chɨmbu ʉmʉkari aabhumbirwɨ kurwa kumusubhɨ, ɨbhuɨbhu umusubhɨ ahiibhurwa nʉ ʉmʉkari. Nawe ebhegero bhyʉsi bhɨrarwa kwa Mungu.
Nangʉ mʉtɨnɨrɨ abheene, ereenderwa ʉmʉkari kʉsabha Mungu atakundikirya umutwɨ gwazɨ?
Nʉʉrʉ ibhiimʉ bhyʉ ʉmʉbhɨrɨ ibhyene bhereerecha kʉbha nɨ‑sʉni kumusubhɨ kʉbha na zinzwɨrɨ ndɨɨhu!
Nawe kʉmʉkari kʉbha na zinzwɨrɨ ndɨɨhu kʉramokora asuukwɨ, kʉ kʉbha ahɨɨrwɨ zinzwɨrɨ ndɨɨhu korereke zɨbhɨ ncha zengebho zu ukukundikirya umutwɨ.
Nawe arɨɨbhɨ ʉmʉʉtʉ areenda kʉhakaana igʉrʉ wa amangʼana gayo, amenye kʉbha itwɨ tʉtaana simʉka zɨndɨ kʉkɨra ziyo, nʉʉrʉ amasengerero ga Mungu gataana simʉka yɨndɨ.
Amangirijʉ igʉrʉ wi ibhyakurya bhyʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ
Igʉrʉ wa ganʉ nikwenda kʉbhatʉma, nɨtakʉbhakumya, kʉ kʉbha hanʉ mukwibhiringa mʉtakokora gu ubhwera, nawe mʉrakora ganʉ gataana bhwera.
Niigwirɨ kʉbha, hanʉ mʉkʉbha mwibhiringirɨ ncha risengerero, kʉnʉ ʉbhʉtaamanʼya gatɨ waanyu. Na niinyɨ ahandɨ niriisirirya kʉbha nɨmbu ɨrɨ.
Ʉbhʉtaamanʼya bhoreenderwa kʉbhaho gatɨgatɨ waanyu, korereke bha amaheene bhamenyekane.
Nawe nangʉ, hanʉ mʉhaabha mwibhiringirɨ mʉtahaarya ibhyakurya bhyʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ chɨmbu ikwenderwa,
kʉ kʉbha abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bhararya ibhyakurya bhyabhʉ bhatakʉrɨnda abhandɨ. Riyo rɨrakora abhandɨ bharasaaga nɨ ɨnzara, abhandɨ bhagwatirwɨ.

Nangʉ, mʉtaana inyumba yɨnʉ mʉkʉtʉra kurya na kunywa? Kwakɨ mʉrarega risengerero rya Mungu na kʉbhasuucha bhanʉ bhataana ekegero? Nɨbhabhʉʉrɨrɨkɨ? Nɨbhakumyɨ? Zɨyi! Nɨtakʉbhakumya igʉrʉ wa amangʼana gayo.
Kurya ibhyakurya bhyʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ chɨmbu ikwenderwa
Amiija ganʉ nasʉngʼaanirɨ kurwa kʉMʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu, nego nabhahɨɨrɨ imwɨ, ubhutikʉ bhʉnʉ iichurirwɨ, akagega ʉmʉkaatɨ,
akabhʉʉrɨra Mungu, azʉmiryɨ, akagusunyura, akabhuga, “Gʉnʉ negwe ʉmʉbhɨrɨ gwanɨ gʉnʉ gukuhurukibhwa igʉrʉ waanyu. Mʉbhɨ mʉrakorabhu, ku kunhiita.”
Ɨbhuɨbhu hanʉ bhaamarirɨ kurya ibhyakurya, akagega ekekombe, akabhuga, “Idivaayi
yɨnʉ ni‑chɨrɨkɨnʼyʉ chʉ ʉbhʉragɨ
ubhuhya bhʉnʉ Mungu akokora, kʉhɨtɨra amasaahɨ gaanɨ. Mʉbhɨ mʉrakorabhu, ku kunhiita!”
Na hanʉ mukurya ʉmʉkaatɨ guyo na kunywɨra ekekombe kiyo, mʉrabha mʉraraganʼya ukukwa kʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ kuhika hanʉ akuuza.
Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ akurya ʉmʉkaatɨ guyo hamwɨ kunywɨra ekekombe kiyo chɨmbu ɨtakwenderwa, arabha akʉrirɨ ʉbhʉbhɨ, kʉ kʉbha arɨgirɨ ʉmʉbhɨrɨ na amasaahɨ gʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ.
Ɨbhu, abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bhiibhuuryɨ abheene, neho bharyɨ ʉmʉkaatɨ na kunywɨra ekekombe.
Nɨragambabhu, kʉ kʉbha ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akurya ʉmʉkaatɨ na kunywɨra ekekombe nawe atakwobhoora kʉbha anu ubhumwɨmwɨ nʉ ʉmʉbhɨrɨ gwʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ, wuyo arabha ariitʉʉra umwene mʉtɨnɨrʉ ya Mungu.
Kiyo necho kikugirya kʉna abhanyʉʉhɨrɨru na abharwɨrɨ bhaaru gatɨ waanyu, na abhandɨ bhakuurɨ.
Twangiyangariirɨ itubheene, Mungu ataarɨ aratʉtɨnɨra.
Nawe nangʉ, hanʉ tukutinirwa nʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ, tʉrabha turiijibhwa, korereke Mungu ataaza kʉtʉtɨnɨra chɨmbu abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhatamwɨzɨ.
Abhahiiri bhaanɨ, hanʉ mukwibhiringa kurya ibhyakurya bhyʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ, mwirɨndɨ.
Arɨɨbhɨ ʉmʉʉtʉ anɨ ɨnzara, abhɨ ararya yɨɨka waazɨ, korereke kwibhiringa kwanyu kʉtabhakorera ukutinirwa. Amangʼana agandɨ ganʉ gasaagirɨ, hanʉ nikuuza nɨragatʉʉra bhwaheene.
